description: This kit contains: 1 Car Wash Shampoo (500 ml), 1 Tyre Dresser (500 ml), 1 Dashboard Dresser (500 ml), 1 Liquid Wax (200 ml), and 1 Microfiber Cloth. CAR WASH SHAMPOO - Our Concentrated high foam PH-Neutral formula gives a quick and long lasting Clean car surface free from dirt , Mud , Road Grime and grease. TYRE DRESSER - The car tyre spray is designed to give a rich, glossy look to your tyres and prevent tyres from fading and cracking. DASHBOARD DRESSER : Effectively restores gloss on car dashboards, Door Panels and Trims. Protects car Materials like Plastic, Vinyl and Rubber surfaces from UV Rays, fading and brings back gloss inside your Car. LIQUID WAX - Restores Gloss to Car Paint Surfaces & Protects from UV Rays also forms a super-slick, protective barrier between the car’s paint and the environment, reducing the sticking and build-up of mud, tar, insects and road grime. CURATED CAR CLEANING KIT- The 3M Auto Care Kit is a special assortment of products that are specifically chosen to meet all of your car cleaning, washing, conditioning, rubbing, and polishing requirements. LIQUID WAX-Restores Gloss of your car's painted surfaces and protects from UV rays. Ideal for both hand and machine use. SPECIALITY SHAMPOO-Removes tough dirt & road grime from all types of cars, giving a clean, shiny, and dust free look. pH-balanced formulation protects your car paint and is effective with both hard water and soft water. TYRE DRESSER-The car tyre spray is designed to give a rich glossy, ultra high sheen look to your tyres.The formulation helps prevent tyres from fading and cracking. DASHBOARD DRESSER-Effectively restores gloss of car dashboards, door panels and trims. It keeps your dashboard looking brand new and sparkling black while preventing fading and protecting from UV rays.
